file_list_assertion: 30 accession-scoped RAWs; each appears exactly once in SDRF

group_mapping.CP1/CP2/CP3: three healthy female plasma donors stated in paper Methods
group_mapping.H/L: high or low ex vivo protease concentration; exact quantitative dose not encoded because filename and PRIDE record do not give it
group_mapping.V8/LasB/CG/NE: Staphylococcus aureus V8, Pseudomonas aeruginosa LasB, human cathepsin G, human neutrophil elastase respectively

biological_evidence: Paper Methods state citrated plasma from three healthy female donors, incubated at 37 C with or without specified ex vivo proteases for 24 h before peptide extraction. All CP1-CP3 files map to donor and treatment tokens. PRIDE structured disease dropdown wounds/injuries does not describe these healthy plasma samples and is not used.
technical_evidence: Paper Methods state Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid with DD-MS2 top-speed DDA, HCD 30 NCE, 400-1500 m/z MS1, charge 2-7; PRIDE data protocol states nonspecific cleavage search, 5 ppm precursor and 0.5 Da fragment tolerance. Cleavage agent is not applicable to this endogenous peptidomics preparation; ex vivo proteases are experimental treatments explicitly recorded in characteristics and factors.
limitations: Exact high/low protease amounts were not depositor-mapped to individual filenames, so dose is categorical. Donor ages were not disclosed beyond adult. Ex vivo treatment enzymes are not modeled as proteomic sample-preparation cleavage agents.
